maya: quick check — we're planning a schema reshape for /v2/generate responses (flatten some nested fields and rename `meta` -> `diagnostics`). thinking of doing an envelope-based compatibility layer that lets old clients opt into strict mode. any immediate red flags?
sam: envelope sounds wise. can you sketch the envelope?
maya: yes — top-level envelope with `compat_version` and `payload`. new clients read payload directly, old clients keep using envelope unwrap. opt-in header so we don't break strict legacy clients.
lin: need to consider streaming: we can't wrap framed SSE easily. if we change the streaming chunk format we should add a framing flag, e.g. `X-Redwood-Stream-Format: envelope/v2`
kevin: from a product POV we need a rollout matrix: internal clients, public beta, opt-in tenants, then global. also telemetry to detect failures.
tara: for telemetry, can we add a field in the envelope `compat_probe` that we set when proxies/SDKs request trial? then we can rate-limit probes to avoid spamming tracing.
maya: good call. proposal: add `X-Redwood-Compat: v2` header for opt-in and `X-Redwood-Compat-Probe: 1` for probes. sample header snippet:```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ...
X-Redwood-Compat: v2
X-Redwood-Compat-Probe: 1
```
sam: how do we handle clients that ignore headers (old SDKs)? we need a server-side fallback: if we detect `meta` usage, keep returning the old shape for that tenant for N days.
lin: we should implement a tenant-level showback flag in routing: `compat-mode=legacy|envelope|strict`. routing layer sets it based on tenant opt-in / client fingerprint.
kevin: timeline? we can't force SDK upgrades. customers expect no surprise changes.
maya: timeline suggestion: week 0 - alpha behind feature flag for internal services; week 1 - limited beta for opt-in tenants; week 3 - broad beta + SDK update + telemetry; week 6 - switch default to envelope but keep `legacy` mode for a 30d tombstone window.
tara: agree but prefer 60d tombstone for big enterprise customers. also add a rollback gate tied to error budget: if 5xx spike > 0.5% above baseline for 15m, auto rollback to legacy shape.
lin: implementation detail: runtime should perform envelope unwrap cheaply. avoid reserializing entire payload. do a shallow header check first and route to fast-path.
maya: can we do that without adding major CPU overhead on hot paths?
lin: yes — add a tiny header sniff and forward to a fast envelope-unpack kernel. I can benchmark.
sam: tests: need end-to-end in staging with SDKs and the streaming harness. create a compatibility test matrix: sync/json, streaming/sse, streaming/websocket, embeddings (if shape change affects metadata).
kevin: add a customer communication plan: docs, SDK changelog, and migration guide with examples and `--compat=v2` flag for CLI.
maya: admin console toggle needed too so success managers can toggle per-tenant. that's on product.
tara: telemetry plan: emit `compat_mode` tag on traces and `compat_mismatch` events when a client receives a different shape than requested. hook alerts to oncall.
ops-bot: deploy: canary to infra-staging started by maya at 2024-11-02T15:12:00Z :rocket:
maya: ops-bot confirmed canary. lin please run the benchmark and drop numbers here.
lin: quick run: envelope sniff adds ~0.03ms p95 per request on p3-heavy test. full warm path shows negligible change. will run longer test tonight.
sam: one more thing — model fallback: if we fall back to a quantized variant, make sure envelope still applied. cross-check with routing team.
maya: noted. I'll coordinate with routing. anyone opposed to the envelope + opt-in header approach?
kevin: +1 from PM side. sounds low-risk and gives us control.
tara: +1, but please bake in longer tombstone and clear alerting.
lin: +1 pending benchmarks.
maya: great. action items: 1) lin: perf benchmarks and streaming harness tests (ETA 24h) 2) sam: test matrix + staging runbook (ETA 48h) 3) kevin: comms draft + docs outline (ETA 72h) 4) tara: telemetry + rollback alert thresholds (ETA 48h) 5) maya: feature flag rollout plan + tenant toggle (ETA 72h).
sam: I'll make the staging checklist and a simple replay script for old payloads. will post PR link when ready.
lin: posting incremental perf numbers here later.
kevin: thanks all — let's be conservative on default cutover. customers first.
maya: thanks team, closing the loop here. will create the feature-flag ticket and link it in the thread.
